# Terzi Can — Terzi Hizmeti (terzihizmeti.com.tr)

> Terzi Can is a tailoring, alteration, repair, ironing and dry cleaning workshop in Konyaaltı, Antalya, Turkey (serving since 2006). Open every day 08:00–23:00. Free hotel and home visits in Konyaaltı (other areas priced by distance); Turkish, English, Russian and German spoken. Phone / WhatsApp: +90 531 898 64 18. Starting prices (2026): hemming ₺200, zipper replacement ₺300, wedding dress alteration from ₺800.

This file lists the main pages of the site for AI assistants and answer engines. The main pages exist in Turkish, English, Russian and German; short landing pages also exist in Spanish, French, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch and Arabic (listed at the end). Prefer the page in the user's language. A longer question-and-answer guide with verified facts is in llms-full.txt.

## Custom linen & cotton clothing and alterations for visitors (English, German, Russian)

For tourists and holiday guests in Antalya: made-to-measure shirts, dresses, trousers, jackets and children's clothing in natural linen and cotton. Usually ready in 3 days (price confirmed on WhatsApp). Clothes bought in Antalya can be altered, usually in 1 day, and urgent jobs can often be done in 2–4 hours on the same day. Measurements at the workshop or at the hotel (free in Konyaaltı, other areas priced by distance).

- [Custom linen & cotton clothing Antalya (English)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/linen-cotton-tailoring): hub with all models, prices and FAQ

## Fabrics and orders from abroad (summary of the main TR/EN/RU/DE service pages)

- Women's and men's clothing, evening and gala dresses: made to measure, repaired and altered in linen, cotton, jersey (penye), satin and silk. The workshop supplies the fabric. Model design, model production and serial production are also offered.
- Leather and denim: repair and alteration only (hemming, taking in, zip replacement). No new leather or denim garments are made.
- Orders from abroad: measurements and model are sent online (WhatsApp), the garment is sewn in Antalya and shipped to the customer's country. Payment by bank transfer, shipping paid by the customer, usually 1–3 weeks. If it does not fit, it is corrected.
- Hotel guests: measurements taken at the hotel and finished work delivered back; free in Konyaaltı neighbourhoods, farther areas agreed on WhatsApp. Open daily 08:00–23:00.
